candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. Di pikin get fever and e don last for 2 days. Dem check pikin temperature, e be 38.4°C. Dem do malaria test, and di result na negative. Malaria test dey available for here. For this area, malaria get high risk. Pikin no dey cough or get wahala to breathe. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get rash wey spread for body. Dem no see any obvious reason for di fever. Dem no see red eye. E no get catarrh. E no get stiff neck. E never get measles in di past 3 months. E no dey cough wey follow measles. Dem no see any sign say bacteria dey cause the fever. Pikin no dey convulse now. E never convulse before. E no dey weak or dey unconscious. E fit drink or suck breast. E no dey vomit everything.
